definitions.name: natne
definitions.body: not = a b
definitions.summary: Natural-number disequality.

definitions.name: positive
definitions.summary: Strict positivity.

definitions.name: ge
definitions.body: le b a
definitions.summary: Greater-than-or-equal relation.

definitions.name: gt
definitions.body: < b a
definitions.summary: Greater-than relation.

definitions.name: between
definitions.body: and le a b le b c
definitions.summary: Closed natural-number interval membership.

definitions.name: natdiff
definitions.body: = a + b c
definitions.summary: Truncated-free subtraction graph: a minus b equals c when b is at most a.

definitions.name: minrel
definitions.body: or and le a b = c a and le b a = c b
definitions.summary: Graph of minimum on naturals.

definitions.name: maxrel
definitions.body: or and le a b = c b and le b a = c a
definitions.summary: Graph of maximum on naturals.

definitions.name: properdivides
definitions.body: and divides a b < a b
definitions.summary: Proper divisor relation.

definitions.name: composite
definitions.body: exists x0 exists x1 and < S 0 x0 and < S 0 x1 = a * x0 x1
definitions.summary: Composite positive natural.

definitions.name: coprime
definitions.body: forall x0 implies and divides x0 a divides x0 b = x0 S 0
definitions.summary: The only common positive divisor is one.

definitions.name: gcdrel
definitions.body: and divides c a and divides c b forall x0 implies and divides x0 a divides x0 b divides x0 c
definitions.summary: Greatest common divisor by its universal divisibility property.

definitions.name: lcmrel
definitions.body: and divides a c and divides b c forall x0 implies and divides a x0 divides b x0 divides c x0
definitions.summary: Least common multiple by its universal divisibility property.

definitions.name: congruent
definitions.body: and positive c exists x0 exists x1 = + a * c x0 + b * c x1
definitions.summary: Congruence modulo c without a subtraction primitive.

definitions.name: remainder
definitions.body: and < c b congruent a c b
definitions.summary: Remainder c of a modulo positive b.

definitions.name: square
definitions.body: exists x0 = a * x0 x0
definitions.summary: Perfect square.

definitions.name: cube
definitions.body: exists x0 = a * * x0 x0 x0
definitions.summary: Perfect cube.

definitions.name: sumtwosquares
definitions.body: exists x0 exists x1 = a + * x0 x0 * x1 x1
definitions.summary: Representation as a sum of two squares.

definitions.name: sumfoursquares
definitions.body: exists x0 exists x1 exists x2 exists x3 = a + * x0 x0 + * x1 x1 + * x2 x2 * x3 x3
definitions.summary: Representation as a sum of four squares.

definitions.name: pythagorean
definitions.body: = + * a a * b b * c c
definitions.summary: Pythagorean triple equation.

definitions.name: pellsolution
definitions.body: = * b b + S 0 * a * c c
definitions.summary: Positive Pell equation solution x squared minus d y squared equals one.

definitions.name: quadraticresidue
definitions.body: and positive b exists x0 congruent * x0 x0 a b
definitions.summary: Quadratic residue modulo b.

definitions.name: squarefree
definitions.body: forall x0 implies divides * x0 x0 a = x0 S 0
definitions.summary: No nontrivial square divides a.

definitions.name: valuation
definitions.body: and prime a and positive b exists x0 exists x1 and pow a c x0 and pow a S c x1 and divides x0 b not divides x1 b
definitions.summary: Prime-adic valuation c of nonzero b.

definitions.name: perfectpower
definitions.body: exists x0 exists x1 and < S 0 x0 and < S 0 x1 pow x0 x1 a
definitions.summary: Power with base and exponent greater than one.

definitions.name: multiplicativeorder
definitions.body: and < S 0 b and coprime a b and < 0 c and exists x0 and pow a c x0 congruent x0 S 0 b forall x1 implies and < 0 x1 < x1 c exists x2 and pow a x1 x2 not congruent x2 S 0 b
definitions.summary: Order of a unit modulo b greater than one: the least positive exponent giving one.

definitions.name: mersenne
definitions.body: exists x0 and pow S S 0 b x0 = x0 S a
definitions.summary: a equals two to b minus one.

definitions.name: fermatnumber
definitions.body: exists x0 exists x1 and pow S S 0 b x0 and pow S S 0 x0 x1 = a S x1
definitions.summary: a equals two to the power two to b plus one.

definitions.name: seqat
definitions.body: beta a b c d
definitions.summary: High-level finite sequence lookup hiding the beta primitive.

definitions.name: seqsum
definitions.body: exists x0 exists x1 and seqat x0 x1 0 0 and seqat x0 x1 c d forall x2 implies < x2 c exists x3 exists x4 exists x5 and seqat a b x2 x3 and seqat x0 x1 x2 x4 and seqat x0 x1 S x2 x5 = x5 + x4 x3
definitions.summary: Sum of the first c entries of a coded natural sequence.

definitions.name: seqprod
definitions.body: exists x0 exists x1 and seqat x0 x1 0 S 0 and seqat x0 x1 c d forall x2 implies < x2 c exists x3 exists x4 exists x5 and seqat a b x2 x3 and seqat x0 x1 x2 x4 and seqat x0 x1 S x2 x5 = x5 * x4 x3
definitions.summary: Product of the first c entries of a coded natural sequence.

definitions.name: factorial
definitions.body: exists x0 exists x1 and seqat x0 x1 0 S 0 and seqat x0 x1 a b forall x2 implies < x2 a exists x3 exists x4 and seqat x0 x1 x2 x3 and seqat x0 x1 S x2 x4 = x4 * x3 S x2
definitions.summary: Factorial graph through a hidden certified recurrence trace.

definitions.name: fibonacci
definitions.body: exists x0 exists x1 and seqat x0 x1 0 0 and seqat x0 x1 S 0 S 0 and seqat x0 x1 a b forall x2 implies < S x2 a exists x3 exists x4 exists x5 and seqat x0 x1 x2 x3 and seqat x0 x1 S x2 x4 and seqat x0 x1 S S x2 x5 = x5 + x3 x4
definitions.summary: Fibonacci graph through a hidden certified recurrence trace.

definitions.name: binomial
definitions.body: or exists x0 exists x1 exists x2 exists x3 and natdiff a b x0 and factorial a x1 and factorial b x2 and factorial x0 x3 = x1 * c * x2 x3 and < a b = c 0
definitions.summary: Total binomial coefficient graph, with value zero when b exceeds a.

definitions.name: arithterm
definitions.body: = d + a * b c
definitions.summary: Term d of an arithmetic progression with start a, difference b, index c.

definitions.name: geomterm
definitions.body: exists x0 and pow b c x0 = d * a x0
definitions.summary: Term d of a geometric progression with start a, ratio b, index c.

definitions.name: arithsum
definitions.body: exists x0 exists x1 and seqsum x0 x1 c d forall x2 implies < x2 c exists x3 and seqat x0 x1 x2 x3 arithterm a b x2 x3
definitions.summary: Finite arithmetic progression sum.

definitions.name: geomseries
definitions.body: exists x0 exists x1 and seqsum x0 x1 c d forall x2 implies < x2 c exists x3 and seqat x0 x1 x2 x3 geomterm a b x2 x3
definitions.summary: Finite geometric progression sum.

definitions.name: divisorcount
definitions.body: and positive a exists x0 exists x1 and seqat x0 x1 0 0 and seqat x0 x1 a b forall x2 implies < x2 a exists x3 exists x4 and seqat x0 x1 x2 x3 and seqat x0 x1 S x2 x4 and implies divides S x2 a = x4 S x3 implies not divides S x2 a = x4 x3
definitions.summary: Number of positive divisors of a.

definitions.name: divisorsum
definitions.body: and positive a exists x0 exists x1 and seqat x0 x1 0 0 and seqat x0 x1 a b forall x2 implies < x2 a exists x3 exists x4 and seqat x0 x1 x2 x3 and seqat x0 x1 S x2 x4 and implies divides S x2 a = x4 + x3 S x2 implies not divides S x2 a = x4 x3
definitions.summary: Sum of positive divisors of a.

definitions.name: eulerphi
definitions.body: and positive a exists x0 exists x1 and seqat x0 x1 0 0 and seqat x0 x1 a b forall x2 implies < x2 a exists x3 exists x4 and seqat x0 x1 x2 x3 and seqat x0 x1 S x2 x4 and implies coprime S x2 a = x4 S x3 implies not coprime S x2 a = x4 x3
definitions.summary: Euler totient count on residues one through a.

definitions.name: perfectnumber
definitions.body: and positive a exists x0 and divisorsum a x0 = x0 + a a
definitions.summary: Positive divisor sum equals twice the number.

definitions.name: abundantnumber
definitions.body: and positive a exists x0 and divisorsum a x0 < + a a x0
definitions.summary: Divisor sum exceeds twice the number.

definitions.name: deficientnumber
definitions.body: and positive a exists x0 and divisorsum a x0 < x0 + a a
definitions.summary: Divisor sum is below twice the number.

definitions.name: inteq
definitions.body: = + a d + c b
definitions.summary: Equality of integer pairs a minus b and c minus d.

definitions.name: intle
definitions.body: le + a d + c b
definitions.summary: Order on integer pairs.

definitions.name: intlt
definitions.body: < + a d + c b
definitions.summary: Strict order on integer pairs.

definitions.name: intadd
definitions.body: inteq e f + a c + b d
definitions.summary: Addition graph for integer pairs.

definitions.name: intmul
definitions.body: inteq e f + * a c * b d + * a d * b c
definitions.summary: Multiplication graph for integer pairs.

definitions.name: intneg
definitions.body: inteq c d b a
definitions.summary: Negation graph for integer pairs.

definitions.name: intabs
definitions.body: or = a + b c = b + a c
definitions.summary: Natural absolute value of an integer pair.

definitions.name: qvalid
definitions.body: positive c
definitions.summary: Well-formed signed rational pair numerator over positive denominator.

definitions.name: qeq
definitions.body: and positive c and positive f inteq * a f * b f * d c * e c
definitions.summary: Equality of signed rationals (a-b)/c and (d-e)/f.

definitions.name: qle
definitions.body: and positive c and positive f intle * a f * b f * d c * e c
definitions.summary: Order on signed rationals.

definitions.name: qlt
definitions.body: and positive c and positive f intlt * a f * b f * d c * e c
definitions.summary: Strict order on signed rationals.

definitions.name: qadd
definitions.body: and qvalid a b c and qvalid d e f and qvalid g h i qeq g h i + * a f * d c + * b f * e c * c f
definitions.summary: Addition graph for signed rationals.

definitions.name: qmul
definitions.body: and qvalid a b c and qvalid d e f and qvalid g h i qeq g h i + * a d * b e + * a e * b d * c f
definitions.summary: Multiplication graph for signed rationals.

definitions.name: qneg
definitions.body: qeq d e f b a c
definitions.summary: Negation graph for signed rationals.

definitions.name: qabs
definitions.body: and positive e or and le b a qeq a b c d 0 e and le a b qeq b a c d 0 e
definitions.summary: Nonnegative rational absolute value of a signed rational.

definitions.name: ratbetween
definitions.body: and ratle c d a b ratle a b e f
definitions.summary: A nonnegative rational lies in a closed rational interval.

definitions.name: ratabsle
definitions.body: and positive b and positive d and positive f and le * f * a d + * f * c b * e * b d le * f * c b + * f * a d * e * b d
definitions.summary: Absolute difference of two nonnegative rationals is at most e/f.

definitions.name: ratabslt
definitions.body: and positive b and positive d and positive f and < * f * a d + * f * c b * e * b d < * f * c b + * f * a d * e * b d
definitions.summary: Absolute difference of two nonnegative rationals is below e/f.

definitions.name: sqrtlower
definitions.body: and positive c < * b b * a * c c
definitions.summary: b/c is a strict lower bound for the nonnegative square root of a.

definitions.name: sqrtupper
definitions.body: and positive c < * a * c c * b b
definitions.summary: b/c is a strict upper bound for the nonnegative square root of a.

definitions.name: sqrtinterval
definitions.body: and sqrtlower a b c sqrtupper a d e
definitions.summary: Rational interval enclosing the nonnegative square root of a.

definitions.name: nthrootlower
definitions.body: and positive b and positive d exists x0 exists x1 and pow c b x0 and pow d b x1 < x0 * a x1
definitions.summary: c/d is a strict lower bound for the positive b-th root of a.

definitions.name: nthrootupper
definitions.body: and positive b and positive d exists x0 exists x1 and pow c b x0 and pow d b x1 < * a x1 x0
definitions.summary: c/d is a strict upper bound for the positive b-th root of a.

definitions.name: nthrootexact
definitions.body: and positive b and positive d exists x0 exists x1 and pow c b x0 and pow d b x1 = x0 * a x1
definitions.summary: c/d is exactly the positive b-th root of a.

statements.name: euclid-primes-statement
statements.body: forall x0 exists x1 and < x0 x1 prime x1
statements.summary: There are arbitrarily large primes.

statements.name: division-algorithm-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 implies positive x1 exists x2 exists x3 and = x0 + * x1 x2 x3 < x3 x1
statements.summary: Division with quotient and a smaller remainder.

statements.name: gcd-existence-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 exists x2 gcdrel x0 x1 x2
statements.summary: Every pair of naturals has a greatest common divisor.

statements.name: lcm-existence-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 exists x2 lcmrel x0 x1 x2
statements.summary: Every pair of positive naturals has a least common multiple.

statements.name: gcd-lcm-product-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 forall x3 implies and gcdrel x0 x1 x2 lcmrel x0 x1 x3 = * x2 x3 * x0 x1
statements.summary: The product of gcd and lcm equals the product of the inputs.

statements.name: prime-divisor-statement
statements.body: forall x0 implies < S 0 x0 exists x1 and prime x1 divides x1 x0
statements.summary: Every natural above one has a prime divisor.

statements.name: bezout-coprime-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 implies coprime x0 x1 exists x2 exists x3 exists x4 exists x5 inteq + * x0 x2 * x1 x4 + * x0 x3 * x1 x5 S 0 0
statements.summary: Coprime naturals admit a signed Bezout identity.

statements.name: crt-two-moduli-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 forall x3 implies and positive x2 and positive x3 coprime x2 x3 exists x4 and congruent x4 x0 x2 congruent x4 x1 x3
statements.summary: Chinese remainder theorem for two coprime moduli.

statements.name: fermat-little-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 implies prime x1 exists x2 and pow x0 x1 x2 congruent x2 x0 x1
statements.summary: Fermat's little theorem in a^p congruent a form.

statements.name: euler-theorem-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 implies and positive x1 and coprime x0 x1 eulerphi x1 x2 exists x3 and pow x0 x2 x3 congruent x3 S 0 x1
statements.summary: Euler's theorem for coprime base and modulus.

statements.name: wilson-statement
statements.body: forall x0 implies prime x0 exists x1 exists x2 and natdiff x0 S 0 x1 and factorial x1 x2 congruent x2 x1 x0
statements.summary: Wilson's theorem: (p-1)! is congruent to -1 modulo p.

statements.name: fermat-two-squares-statement
statements.body: forall x0 implies and prime x0 congruent x0 S 0 S S S S 0 sumtwosquares x0
statements.summary: A prime congruent to one modulo four is a sum of two squares.

statements.name: lagrange-four-squares-statement
statements.body: forall x0 sumfoursquares x0
statements.summary: Every natural is a sum of four squares.

statements.name: pell-existence-statement
statements.body: forall x0 implies and positive x0 not square x0 exists x1 exists x2 and positive x2 pellsolution x0 x1 x2
statements.summary: Every positive nonsquare parameter has a nontrivial Pell solution.

statements.name: squarefree-divisor-statement
statements.body: forall x0 exists x1 exists x2 and squarefree x1 and square x2 = x0 * x1 x2
statements.summary: Every natural has a squarefree-times-square decomposition.

statements.name: order-divides-phi-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 forall x3 implies and multiplicativeorder x0 x1 x2 eulerphi x1 x3 divides x2 x3
statements.summary: Multiplicative order divides Euler's totient.

statements.name: divisorcount-square-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 implies and positive x0 divisorcount x0 x1 iff even x1 not square x0
statements.summary: The divisor count is odd exactly for squares.

statements.name: prime-deficient-statement
statements.body: forall x0 implies prime x0 deficientnumber x0
statements.summary: Every prime is deficient.

statements.name: euclid-even-perfect-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 implies and prime x1 mersenne x1 x0 exists x2 exists x3 exists x4 and natdiff x0 S 0 x3 and pow S S 0 x3 x4 and = x2 * x4 x1 perfectnumber x2
statements.summary: The Euclid construction from a Mersenne prime yields an even perfect number.

statements.name: factorial-zero-statement
statements.body: factorial 0 S 0
statements.summary: Zero factorial equals one.

statements.name: factorial-step-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 implies and factorial x0 x1 factorial S x0 x2 = x2 * S x0 x1
statements.summary: Factorial recurrence.

statements.name: fibonacci-step-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 forall x3 implies and fibonacci x0 x1 and fibonacci S x0 x2 fibonacci S S x0 x3 = x3 + x1 x2
statements.summary: Fibonacci recurrence.

statements.name: binomial-symmetry-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 forall x3 forall x4 implies and natdiff x0 x1 x2 and binomial x0 x1 x3 binomial x0 x2 x4 = x3 x4
statements.summary: Binomial coefficient symmetry.

statements.name: pascal-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 forall x3 forall x4 implies and positive x1 and binomial x0 x1 x2 and binomial x0 x3 x4 natdiff x1 S 0 x3 exists x5 and binomial S x0 x1 x5 = x5 + x2 x4
statements.summary: Pascal's binomial recurrence.

statements.name: arithmetic-series-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 forall x3 implies and positive x2 arithsum x0 x1 x2 x3 exists x4 and natdiff x2 S 0 x4 = * S S 0 x3 * x2 + * S S 0 x0 * x1 x4
statements.summary: Twice an arithmetic sum equals n times twice the start plus (n-1)d.

statements.name: geometric-series-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 forall x3 forall x4 implies and geomseries x0 x1 x2 x3 pow x1 x2 x4 = + * x3 x1 x0 + x3 * x0 x4
statements.summary: Cross-multiplied finite geometric series identity.

statements.name: integer-triangle-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 forall x3 forall x4 forall x5 forall x6 implies and intabs x0 x1 x4 and intabs x2 x3 x5 intabs + x0 x2 + x1 x3 x6 le x6 + x4 x5
statements.summary: Triangle inequality for integer-pair absolute value.

statements.name: rational-density-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 forall x3 forall x4 forall x5 implies qlt x0 x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 exists x6 exists x7 exists x8 and qlt x0 x1 x2 x6 x7 x8 qlt x6 x7 x8 x3 x4 x5
statements.summary: A signed rational lies strictly between any two distinct signed rationals.

statements.name: rational-triangle-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 forall x3 forall x4 forall x5 forall x6 forall x7 forall x8 forall x9 forall x10 forall x11 forall x12 forall x13 forall x14 implies and qadd x0 x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 x6 x7 x8 and qabs x0 x1 x2 x9 x10 and qabs x3 x4 x5 x11 x12 qabs x6 x7 x8 x13 x14 ratle x13 x14 + * x9 x12 * x11 x10 * x10 x12
statements.summary: Triangle inequality for signed rationals.

statements.name: archimedean-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 implies positive x1 exists x2 < x0 * x1 x2
statements.summary: Archimedean bound in natural cross-multiplied form.

statements.name: sqrt-rational-cell-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 implies and positive x0 positive x1 exists x2 exists x3 sqrtinterval x0 x2 x1 x3 x1
statements.summary: Every positive square root is bracketed by rational endpoints of a fixed positive denominator.

statements.name: sqrt-prime-irrational-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 implies and prime x0 and positive x2 coprime x1 x2 not = * x1 x1 * x0 * x2 x2
statements.summary: The square root of a prime has no reduced rational representation.

statements.name: nthroot-rational-criterion-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 forall x3 implies and nthrootexact x0 x1 x2 x3 coprime x2 x3 = x3 S 0
statements.summary: A reduced rational whose positive power is a natural has denominator one.

statements.name: sqrt-interval-order-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 forall x3 forall x4 implies sqrtinterval x0 x1 x2 x3 x4 ratlt x1 x2 x3 x4
statements.summary: A strict square-root interval has its lower endpoint below its upper endpoint.

statements.name: absolute-error-monotone-statement
statements.body: forall x0 forall x1 forall x2 forall x3 forall x4 forall x5 forall x6 forall x7 implies and ratabsle x0 x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 ratle x4 x5 x6 x7 ratabsle x0 x1 x2 x3 x6 x7
statements.summary: An absolute-error certificate remains valid under a larger tolerance.
